title: Clap Switch Ko Seeti Bhi Chala Deti Hai, Kyun? #shorts
description:
Sound sensor taali nahi pehchanta, sirf awaaz ka volume naapta hai. Isliye seeti bhi use trigger kar deti hai!
🎤 Electret mic ke andar diaphragm aur backplate ka kaam
⚡ LM393 comparator aur threshold ka khel
🔧 Neela trimpot se sensitivity set karna
🔌 Arduino se DO pin ka connection
Aur Arduino sensors seekhne ke liye subscribe karo!
#shorts #arduino #soundsensor #ky038 #electronics #hindi #clapswitch
tags: sound sensor kaise kaam karta hai

🔧 Neela trimpot threshold set karta hai
🔊 Pitch nahi dekhta, isliye seeti, taali, knock sab chalte hain
